run_fused_moe_lora_fp8: run fused MoE LoRA inference with FP8 quantization on hidden states and stacked LoRA weights
run_fused_moe_lora_shrink_fp8: run the shrink pass of fused MoE LoRA FP8 kernel to compute intermediate hidden representations
run_fused_moe_lora_expand_fp8: run the expand pass of fused MoE LoRA FP8 kernel to accumulate output into the target tensor
register_custom_ops: register fused_moe_lora_fp8 custom ops with PyTorch's custom op dispatcher for eager mode execution
cache_lora_weight_ptrs: cache LoRA weight tensor pointers in a lookup table to avoid repeated data_ptr lookups during kernel launches
